notes: Fee rule (#59): one application fee (£937, applied for inside the UK only). IHS £1,035 per year x 2: the standard length is 2 years for anyone applying on or before 31 December 2026. The 3-year length is only for PhD / doctoral holders (a variant, not the standard case). VERIFIER: confirm 2, not 3.
DATE-SENSITIVE: from 1 January 2027 the standard length becomes 18 months (IHS £1,552.50 total). Re-record and re-verify this route then.
category: 'work' (the visa is a post-study permission to work / look for work, not to study).
processingDaysMin: the page only says 'within 8 weeks', so any minimum from 0 to 56 days is consistent with it.

name.source: A Graduate visa gives you permission to stay in the UK for at least 18 months after successfully completing an eligible course in the UK.

processingDaysMin.source: you’ll usually get a decision within 8 weeks.
